title: DIP: clients own the service interfaces
purpose: Show interface ownership and inversion across three package layers.
alt: Policy가 Policy Service를 소유하고 Mechanism이 Mechanism Service를 소유해 하위 구현의 의존이 위로 향하는 구조
requiredChecks: Policy package owns Policy Layer and Policy Service interface; Policy Layer uses Policy Service.
Mechanism package owns Mechanism Layer and Mechanism Service; Mechanism Layer implements Policy Service and uses Mechanism Service.
Cross-package source dependencies run Mechanism→Policy and Utility→Mechanism, while interfaces stay owned by their clients.
